physical: In an alternating-current circuit the ratio of voltage to current is the impedance, whose magnitude combines resistance with the inductive and capacitive reactances. |Z| = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²)
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps its shape, with what is defined and what combines unnamed.
rule_reason: A definition keeps its shape even though impedance, electrical resistance and reactance carry resistance. None of those quantities has an individual frozen partner.
interpretation: Receptivity does not supply the missing partners. The gap does not complete the reflection.
closing: The definition rule decides keeps; counting three resistance-bearing variables as three costs would be an additional rule not supplied here. The resistant-to-receptive property flip does not define separate replacements for impedance, electrical resistance and reactance. The physical sum is retained formally rather than replaced with a product.
